name: just-easy-ca-classes-lms
description: Just Easy CA Classes learning platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --dir backend dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend lint && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --dir backend lint:fix && pnpm --dir frontend lint:fix
scripts.format: pnpm --dir backend format && pnpm --dir frontend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir backend format:check && pnpm --dir frontend format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
scripts.infra:local:up: docker compose -f compose.local.yml up -d redis livekit
scripts.infra:local:logs: docker compose -f compose.local.yml logs -f livekit redis
scripts.infra:validate: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/azure init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/azure fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/azure validate && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/aws init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/aws fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/aws validate
